crypto_headlines.title: Trump Media held 15,649 BTC at the end of Q3
crypto_headlines.summary: Cointelegraph reported Trump Media held 15,649 BTC worth $1.31B at the end of Q3 2026, up 35.4% from Q2, with 73% pledged as collateral for options trades. Bitcoin Magazine said it bought a net 1,510 BTC (about $112 million) in the quarter.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance warns of an iOS flaw that could expose seed phrases
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance warned that an iOS flaw called "worse_query" lets malicious apps read other apps' files on iOS 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2, which could expose seed phrases, private keys and logins. Its advice: update iOS and remove apps from untrusted sources.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance to block transfers to MEXC after FinCEN designation
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance will block transfers to MEXC following the US FinCEN designation. MEXC's CEO said the exchange has contacted FinCEN, is ready to cooperate, and is operating as normal.

crypto_headlines.title: Coinbase, Kalshi, Kraken and others back the CFTC on stock perps
crypto_headlines.summary: CoinDesk reported that Coinbase, Kalshi, Payward (Kraken), DRW, Jump Trading and Paradigm filed in support of the CFTC in a legal fight over its authority to regulate stock perpetual futures.

crypto_headlines.title: October CPI lands today; Waller floats a bigger December hike
crypto_headlines.summary: Core CPI is forecast to rise 0.2% month over month in October, down from 0.3% in September. Fed Governor Waller leans toward a 25 bps hike in December if inflation cools and floated 50 bps if core comes in around 0.3% or higher.

crypto_headlines.title: Hyperscale Data sells its entire Bitcoin reserve
crypto_headlines.summary: Hyperscale Data sold its final 211.56 BTC for $16 million, per Cointelegraph. Separately, Cointelegraph noted public companies recorded $8.08B in BTC sales and estimated outflows in 2026, led by miners.

doginal_news.title: Floor slips to 45k DOGE as listings finally appear
doginal_news.summary: Community tracker BradX said one wallet listed 5 Doginal Dogs at 45k to 52k DOGE Monday afternoon, moving the floor from 47k to 45k (about $3.1k). He noted no sale since #495 at 115k DOGE on Nov 3.

doginal_news.title: Legends cards slipped into TCGplayer orders
doginal_news.summary: Wooki is randomly inserting 1st Edition Doginal Dogs Legends cards into TCGplayer orders, with an info sheet and QR code pointing to the free online game.

doginal_news.title: Atlas and Aria pulled from a fresh box
doginal_news.summary: Spade ripped another Legends box and showed off an Atlas and an Aria card.

doginal_news.title: Shield art extension set
doginal_news.summary: homeMetaX shared a custom art extension set for the Shield card from the Legends game.

doginal_news.title: Pyth hosts an executive dinner during Breakpoint London
doginal_news.summary: Pyth announced an invite-only Fintech and Data Executive Dinner in London on November 16 during Breakpoint, for leaders in market data, trading technology and finance.

doginal_news.title: October was a record month for RWA perps on Pyth
doginal_news.summary: BSCN reported Pyth's October figures, which mark a record month for real-world asset perpetuals volume and measure how much US stock perps volume trades after the NYSE closing bell.

notes: No new original posts from @doginaldogs, @DDLTCG, or @thePIRB in the last ~24 hours (replies only). Floor numbers are a community count. Watch out for posts pushing PYTH 'airdrop' or 'allocation checker' links.
